theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_boundary_smul_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M₁ : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (m + 1)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T₁ ω = ∫ x in M₁, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict M₁), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ ‖α‖) → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (ω F : TestFormOn U m), Differentiable ℝ f → (∀ x, (F : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x = f x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) → ENNReal.ofReal |T₁.boundary F| ≤ ∫⁻ x in M₁, ENNReal.ofReal (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (|f x| * ‖fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ * ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x‖)) ∂μHE[m + 1]
